# Source and proposed-reference control

[SOURCE_IDENTITIES.json](SOURCE_IDENTITIES.json) binds all 43 copied inputs to
exact source commit/path or attachment, byte count and SHA-256. Its first 38
rows are unchanged from method-definition r0.2. The five additions are two
owner directives and PTC's summary/detailed ledgers plus MAP's owner ledger.
They make precedence and the remaining upstream decisions inspectable.

[AUTHOR_REFERENCE_INVENTORY.json](AUTHOR_REFERENCE_INVENTORY.json) is
byte-identical to r0.2 and contains exactly the 24 true-flag full source rows.
It is a retained proposed-reference set, not a sanitized author packet or
dispatch authorization. The three process-only program-reference flags agree
in both records. Prior scope-packet permission mismatches remain superseded
by this consistent control; archived files are not rewritten.

| Source group | Proposed reference | Authority |
| --- | --- | --- |
| inputs/authority/fruit, PTC_APPLICATION_REFERENCE.tex and inputs/authority/map | true | Exact retained scientific/status sources within their stated authority; unavailable states remain unavailable. |
| Three inputs/program documents | true | Process-only charter/workflow/sequence; no numerical scientific selection. |
| inputs/manager | false | Recovery and review context, including final PTC/CAL sources, MAP source lock, ledgers, internal dossier and earlier discussion. No automatic author admission. |
| inputs/owner | false | Exact owner instructions governing this manager task; not a future independent-author source set. |

the copied final status-clean sources match its freeze hash table, not an

`3dc912d9f6a58d9f92561ad10b9442485c5b47232e5327389d2fb3b89c296e92`.
Individual final-source identities are in the source record.

B01–B12 are proposals in this paper, not controlled upstream successors. No
VAL source/profile registry or freeze is modified. Copied source links are
non-transitive: they admit no implementation, empirical material, repository
or later upstream candidate by reference. A future author packet requires
exact independent approval. Reduction products and the two opaque archives
are excluded from the inputs and delivery.
